---
name: Add a new genAI agent
about: For adding new genAI agent accounts on Github
title: '[AGENT]: '
labels: 'genAI agent'
assignees: ''
---

**What is the name of the agent?**
EX: Claude, Gemini, etc

**Is it already tracked?**
Please check to see if we're already tracking this agent (the project README has a list)

**Where is the repository that uses it?**
Please include a link of the repository where you found this agent being used.
It should have made commits.

**Link to the account**
If possible, please include a link to the bot's account.
If you are unable to get a link, please just write "no link".

**Github Metadata**
If possible, please include the account/integration ID.
This is advanced so do not worry if you don't have it, someone will be able to find it.
Issues with metadata included will be processed faster.

(you can get this from `https://api.github.com/users/USERNAME` and verify with `https://api.github.com/user/ID`)
